security_details.ED25519_ADVERSARIAL_ENCODINGS: 332 constructed cases vs OpenSSL and libsodium: Bouchaud == libsodium on 332, != OpenSSL on 16 (small-order/non-canonical inputs OpenSSL accepts); defect found and fixed (small-order and non-canonical keys accepted, like OpenSSL 3); mutation-tested: each refusal removed is detected except the negative-zero refusal, which is an equivalent mutation (only x=0 points are identity and order 2, already refused)

security_details.PRODUCTION_RELEASE_KEY: NOT_CONFIGURED on purpose: production update = REFUSED until a human decision (offline/HSM, rotation, backup, revocation)
security_details.ANTI_ROLLBACK_POLICY: a correctly signed OLD release can be reinstalled; local rollback (candidate -> previous Good) must stay possible
security_details.UPDATE_SESSION_ISOLATION: session bound to pid + all install calls serialized under a sleeping mutex; QEMU mise-a-jour-morts (updated killed during write and during verify)
security_details.SIGCHLD_MULTITHREAD_STABILITY: one unexplained failure on main; 125 targeted reproductions on the exact kernel 21fca026 (isolated, under strace at SMP1/2/4, full primitives context): 0 failures; root cause NOT established
security_details.UPDATED_HEARTBEAT: contract v3 unchanged (4 x 250 ms). QEMU TCG on the final tree: mise-a-jour max service gap 666 ms, mise-a-jour-morts 170 ms, no updated Running->Degraded; published (UPDATED_MESURE), not thresholded.
